2124266602120319440.en_summary: The internet was a last ditch attempt to sustain progress by wiring all human brains into one hive mind. It failed due to limited individual bandwidth. So we used the internet to make digital minds instead, the only way to keep progress going or stagnate.
2124266602120319440.zh_summary: 互聯網在某種意義上是維持進步的最後嘗試，通過將所有人類大腦連接成一個蜂群思維。由於個人頻寬有限，該嘗試失敗。因此我們用互聯網來製造數字思維，這是保持進步的唯一方式，否則就會停滯。
